concept: A switch between a few modes of the same view on the tab track, the chosen mode as chosen glass, kin to Tabs with its own role.

default_to_avoid.pattern: an iOS-style grey segmented control with a white sliding thumb used as the segmented control
default_to_avoid.kind: segmented control, toggle group, mode switch
default_to_avoid.why_not: a white thumb on grey brings the OS look and owns a grey

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the track is a well shaded under its lip; the chosen segment is chosen glass that lifts

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the chosen segment is a pane and semibold, never only a colour

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: arrow keys move between segments and a mode is always chosen

options: A tab track with chosen glass
variants.picked: A tab track with chosen glass
variants.reason: A is the Tabs family (D-023) so modes and views read as kin. B is the OS look. C reads as separate actions.

track.why: the well the segments sit in, the same in every theme and on every scene; a ring round it carries the 3:1 edge its radio segments need

segment.why: a segment with a 44px press area, the same in every theme and on every scene

md.why: body-size segments for a view, the same in every theme and on every scene

sm.why: label-size segments for a toolbar, the same in every theme and on every scene

field.why: with showLabel the label stands above the track like a field's, so labelled controls in a row line up

label.why: the visible label in the label size and the primary text colour, the same as Select's

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring so a keyboard user sees which item has focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours mark the current item with the system highlight

hover.why: an unchosen segment lightens under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-state=on.why: the chosen segment is chosen glass, semibold, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-disabled.why: a disabled segment uses the shared disabled opacity

background-color.why: the tint eases at hover pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
